text:
Maria Chen: Quick heads-up — I just finished an autoresponder audit for the webinar signup flow. Wanted feedback on the proposed changes before we push. TL;DR: tighten segmentation, trim intro, add 2-step nurture for demo-ready leads.

Alex Patel: nice, can you drop the doc?

Maria Chen: here: https://docs.google.com/example-webinar-autoresponder (commented the key changes). Main asks: 1) subject lines for two-day winback, 2) routing rules to SDR queue, 3) soft vs hard unsubscribe behavior.

Samir Gupta: skimmed — looks solid. For routing, suggest: if opens > 1 and CTA click -> SDR, else continue nurture for 3 more emails.

Jordan Lee: +1 on Samir. Also think we should AB test subject lines: `Quick invite` vs `Seats filling fast — your demo` — see open rate lift.

Emily Rivera: re: segmentation, can we add tag for "benchmark-request" leads? They usually convert faster. I can update the webhook to include that flag.

Maria Chen: great — Emily, can you add that tag and set rule: `benchmark-request == true` -> tier-1 SDR immediate routing.

Alex Patel: question on frequency — current flow sends email every 2 days. Can we compress to 36 hrs for demo-intent folks?

Samir Gupta: compressing helps but watch rate limits. We should only compress if user meets demo-intent: clicked scheduling link or responded. Otherwise keep 48 hrs.

Maria Chen: agreed. I'll update the doc and push a PR to the automation playbook.

marketing-bot: Reminder: campaign test window scheduled in Staging on 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC. Use `autoresponder-v2` config.

Jordan Lee: can someone assemble 3 subject line variants + preview text? I'll set up the AB test in Iterable.

Emily Rivera: I'll get 3 variants by EOD. Roughs: 1) "You're on the list — next steps", 2) "Quick invite: demo seats for [Company]", 3) "Benchmark your LLM costs — webinar invite".

Alex Patel: also add a footer blurb about data residency for Enterprise leads — important for Private prospects.

Maria Chen: noted. Final checklist: segmentation rules, subject variants, routing rules, compressed cadence gating, unsubscribe safety. I'll update doc and tag everyone for review. :thumbsup:

Samir Gupta: thanks — like the pragmatic approach. Happy to review copy tomorrow.

Jordan Lee: quick ask: can we include a 1-question survey in email 2 to capture use-case? small inline CTA.

Maria Chen: yes — single radio question. I'll draft options.

marketing-bot: Campaign config `autoresponder-v2` created by Maria Chen at 1876543500.
